office_does: A Benton County District Court judge, elected countywide for four years, hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor cases, traffic and other infractions, small claims, anti-harassment matters and civil cases up to $100,000.
race_blurb: Judge John Ziobro, who has held Position 4 since his 2017 appointment and won it in 2022, is not on the 2026 ballot. District Court Commissioner Jennifer Johnson is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Benton County District Court commissioner since January 2025; former Benton County deputy prosecutor and defense attorney who sat as a judge pro tem for 10 years. The only candidate for the seat Judge John Ziobro holds.
highlights: Benton County deputy prosecutor from 2007, later a criminal defense attorney [S1][S2]
Judge pro tem for 10 years in Benton and Franklin District Courts and Pasco Municipal Court [S2]
